text: My dental filling with Dr.Siriwadee went smoothly. She explained everything in detail which made me feel comfortable. Her assistant was also great at making sure that it was a positive experience
The receptionist was attentive and provided excellent service. The dentist also gave helpful recommendations on how to take care of my oral health.
Clean and fast service. The dentist is kind and willing to answer every questions and concerns.

Extremely unprofessional and careless treatment. During a routine cleaning, Dr. Sunisa Gambhir broke my braces and refused to take responsibility, instead blaming the patient. I do not recommend this doctor to anyone. Save your time and avoid this practice.
Confidence smile start here Bangkok smile Dental Clinic at Silom branch, Amazing service! Highly recommend.⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Dr Meghna is patient and skillful. Scaling and polishing was done perfectly, gentle and not painful. Did zoom whitening and the process was very pleasant. Will definitely come back again
Great clinic, everything was well🦷💪

I recently had an ultrasonic teeth cleaning (Air Flow Ultrasonic Cleaning) and it was absolutely great!
The procedure was very fast, incredibly gentle, and highly effective. The staff were kind, professional, and very friendly — they put me at ease the whole time.
Special thanks to the whole team for the excellent care! I’m so happy with how everything turned out
Great service, very professional. High recommended.

That was actually probably the worst dental service I’ve ever experienced in my life. Congratulations.

I showed up 15 minutes late because of my driver and traffic. I let them know that I tried to call but nobody answered and when I arrived I asked if I needed to reschedule. I knew I was at fault here so I was happy to do whatever they needed to do with the situation.

Instead, they didn’t say anything and immediately went to check me in where I had a woman fill out my forms without asking me about any of my medical conditions. I watched her as she marked “no” for everything.  LOL. Immediately brings me upstairs into a room with the doctor playing music.

I asked the dentist what the different treatments were since we didn’t confirm the type of cleaning I would receive (via email or at the front desk) and I wanted to confirm pricing before being treated. He immediately got upset and said we are already 25 mins late and to hurry up and lay back.

I apologized again for being late and stated that if he was going to be rushed, they should not have taken me in as a patient. I also said that when I’m paying for a service, I’m allowed to ask a simple question. He became so flustered and upset that I no longer felt safe in the room, so I got up and left.

I work in medicine and I’ve never seen a “doctor” so quick to lose composure. If this is how he reacts when a patient asks a simple question, I can’t imagine how he handles anything more complex. The ego and lack of emotional control he showed has no place in patient care.

You’re not saving lives, you’re cleaning teeth.

Superb experience!, felt a bit scared to go there as a foreigner but the dentists and staff also clinic were great.
Everything gets explained to you step by step.
Tysm☺️

Went there to do a cleaning & fillings. At first, the doctor seemed professional and knowledgeable, with decent English which is really important. Although, once the cleaning started (which turned out implies only scaling and polishing, or half of teeth polished) it became super painful (scaling). Obviously, I have something to compare it to. Second part with polishing has been done really quickly and not precisely, covering only some part of the teeth. And yeah, no AirFlow has been done or offered, as I asked for a full cleaning which usually implies scaling and AirFlow as a standard.

The second part with fillings was pretty much okay till the point when the doctor started polishing it. It took her around 15-20 min to finish polishing it (i have no idea what that was and why it took so long, but that was not promising good result).

After roughly 2 weeks the filling is okay, although I came to a doctor in Europe to double check my teeth and it turned out that I have a lot of calculus. So I had to pay again for a cleaning, having no idea what I have paid for before at Bangkok Smile.

My Husband and I always fly all the way from Germany just for the excellent dental services in Thailand. Bangkok Smile Dental is always nice, caring and considerate to us. Making appointment is definitely hassle free and they are really professional und hospitable. The Dentists (as well as the Front Desk Staff) are all reliable and can speak good English. We are always looking forward on our annual Bangkok visit. See you next year, BSD Family 🫶🏻
Good service! The staffs are very nice.
All services are great, highly recommend😘

I broke my front tooth while in Bangkok. I went to this clinic to get my tooth repaired. The repair required two visits, first to prep the tooth and get a temporary cap, and then to get the permanent cap.

I was THOROUGHLY impressed with the entire process.  Every single one of the staff I encountered was professional, courteous and friendly.

The Dentist, Dr. Raviporn Madarasmi, was excellent. She speaks English very well, she thoroughly explained every step of the way in the procedure. I was surprised to find out she went to school at UCLA in the USA. Thank you Dr. I love my new front tooth!

The price was very affordable. I paid about 1/4 what this would have cost in the USA.

The location is hard to find at first. There is a shopping center and large parking garage just behind the building where the Dental clinic is located. The shopping center is called Thaniya Shopping Mall.

The clinic at silom is quite small,suffocating..
The service of the receptionists made it worse. They stared at us, seem like hesitated to communicate with us. I did tooth extraction, one of the receptionists treated like I can't afford and all she mentioned was about the price. 😅 Not about how to relieve my pain.

I met 3 doctors, One did for my Xray and general check up of my tooth. She was super nice. She handed over me to senior one to do more precised tests. That specialist or senior doctor was terrible like TERRIBLE. Both the way she treated me and my pain. Then, she handed over again to another young doctor to do tooth extraction. The doctor is nice and compassionate. Also her assistant was.

I had severe toothace during that day. As i live nearby and also because of good reviews, I chose Bangkom smile. But now, it is my "never go to" clinic.

I've been Bangkok Smile  many times over few years for regular dental check up cleaning . I've always been nervous at dentist but here Excellent Dentist and staff team they took time to explain details very comfortable. They don't force you to do unnecessary treatment and reasonable price. I would highly recommend
"I even can smile after wisdom teeth extracted '' it wasn't bad as I imagined  .. thank you
Good experience, good consulting kub

My experience was top tier. The staff was friendly and very knowledgeable. I had my teeth cleaned and received Zoom whitening service. It was painless and the results were very good. I recommend this facility.
